dependency_edges.handoff: Star vector and review text feed CE context scoring.
CE and VADER vectors feed fused sentiment.
Fused sentiment and stars feed importance ranking.
Reputation feeds AR forecast and fuzzy outcome.
Forecast and extreme-rating outputs feed descriptor analysis.
Descriptors, informative reviews and forecast classes feed product strategy and letter.

algorithm.convergence_criteria: No reproducible convergence, residual, calibration, lexicon agreement, forecast stopping, or strategy monitoring rule is reported.
software: Python-like source code appendices, VADER, contextual entropy, DTW, difference equation, AR, Bayes and word-cloud routines are shown, but versions, inputs and seeds are not frozen.

assumptions: Treat ratings/reviews as usable but imperfect observations, five product records as comparable after explicit field choices, and the selected time/product scope as the analysis boundary.
Separate representation, sentiment, importance, reputation, forecast, association, feature, and strategy claims; do not promote association or simulation to causal effect.

governing_equations.label: Eq.4 / KL divergence
governing_equations.normalized_latex: D(c\Vert s)=\sum_k P(d_k\mid c)\log(P(d_k\mid c)/P(d_k\mid s))
governing_equations.source_expression: candidate and seed context distributions are compared directionally

governing_equations.label: Eq.5 / symmetric context distance

governing_equations.label: Eq.8 / review-group similarity
governing_equations.purpose: score a review against a class
governing_equations.source_expression: candidate-word scores are averaged for a review
governing_equations.source_note: q210 formula structure reconciled against page text and bounded visual proxies; original 200-DPI rasters remain authoritative for small glyphs.

governing_equations.label: Eq.9 / CE intensity
governing_equations.source_expression: five group similarities are normalized
governing_equations.source_note: q210 formula structure reconciled against page text and bounded visual proxies; original 200-DPI rasters remain authoritative for small glyphs.
